regions.merged_text: Liss Marjorie Franklin and all our Friends at 6250 Woodward Ave. Detroit, Mich. May the Lord bless and smile on each one of you and all together! Rev. Father Guardian and others of our Cap Community thought it would be appropriate that we send you on the Eve of our national Thanksgiving Day, at least a short word of our appreciation for your wholeheart'd kindness in so generously corresponding with and seconding the wishes and ideals of our late friend and lamented benefector Jerry Mccarthy. May his open confession and candid expression of regret, etc for his habitual blasphemy be laid to his credit. This especially, since Today we had the first actual results after so long suspense and fully satisfactory operation of the new Drier.
